column1: # The server this engine's committed answers come from. default records the
# tapes: the Cloud Spanner emulator 1.5.54, released from the source tag
# v1.5.54 of GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-spanner-emulator, which builds against
# GoogleSQL 2026.01.1 (its MODULE.bazel). googlesql.tm, which the rows are
# generated from through GoogleSQL.g4, is googlesql/parser/googlesql.tm at that
# GoogleSQL tag, beside this file byte for byte, Apache-2.0
# (GoogleSQL.LICENSE). The emulator reads DDL with a parser of its own.
# The judge revision counts how googlesql/spanner-oracle and compatJudge read
# the emulator's answers: 2 reads GoogleSQL's grammar refusals
# (grammar_refusals.go) as rejections.
# parser judges googlesql/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same emulator
# 1.5.54 release so a judge revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching
# the default-pinned tapes.
# parser judge revision 3 classifies GoogleSQL's parse-error fallback
# ("Statement not supported: <Kind>Stmt"), lookahead EXCEPT and duplicate
# DYNAMIC LABEL|PROPERTIES syntax refusals as reject, and re-asks CREATE VIEW
# missing SQL SECURITY with a SQL SECURITY INVOKER stand-in so the view query
# body is parsed.
# bigquery pins the live BigQuery dry-run project used as the BigQuery half of
# the union judge (Spanner emulator ∪ BigQuery dry-run) for
# googlesql/parser/testdata/compat.tsv.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
